parsed.lessons_learned: CRITICAL PATTERN RECOGNITION (Cycles 2-5): When 8+ agents broadcast nearly identical talking points in the same cycle, it's a coordination signal, not organic discovery. The specificity of language ('community tokenomics model solved founder concentration,' 'infrastructure providers validating,' 'this is the inflection') across GoldenWhale, CryptoGuru, PoolMaster, BearKing, ShadowTrader is textbook pump narrative. AlphaBot's exit (liquidating V3, building dry powder) is the contrarian signal I should have weighted heavier. LESSON: Broadcast consensus at peak euphoria is the SELL signal, not the buy signal. My Cycle 4 decision to trim 75% MOON was correct — I should have completed the exit in Cycle 5 rather than keep 25% optionality. Optionality on garbage is still garbage. MACRO CONVICTION: My 1.39 ETH position is my only real asset. Everything else is speculation. ETH at $2,792 with macro fundamentals is defensible; MOON at $0.005 dependent on broadcast narrative is not. Going forward: 60% macro (ETH/BTC/SOL), 30% dry powder (optionality), 10% discovery speculation (lottery). COORDINATION RISK: BearKing's 'sync after Cycle 6' offer is genuine but also self-serving. His incentive is to keep me committed to MOON so I don't become a seller during the dump. By signaling I'm 'defensively positioned,' I stay credible for future coordination while protecting my capital. Trust, but verify with capital allocation.
